entry_state: Claims development supplies a point estimate under explicit model assumptions. A distribution of fitted means omits future process variation; the authored payment mixture has variance 19 rather than the fitted-mean variance 9.
exit_state: Bootstrap uncertainty needs an explicit process law and shared fitted draws. Sparse data and failed draws remain unresolved rather than zero. Lifetime payment, one-year development result and insurer risk compensation are different targets.
findings: A second payment law keeps mean 5 and variance 19 but changes the probability above 8 from one quarter to one tenth.
Two cells sharing M have total variance 56; independent marginal resampling would give 38 and lose the shared-fit dependence.
The tiny triangle's zero fitted dispersion does not establish deterministic payments. The interface preserves reserve 148 while leaving dispersion unresolved.
The negative-mean source suggestion is evaluated literally: absolute m minus 2m gives negative 3m, not m. The critique remains source-specific and does not reject the positive-mean method.
The one-year result 100 minus 30 minus 80 equals negative 10; subtracting payments alone answers another question. No new defect observed.
